$comment: How the injection matrix (apps/macos/Packages/AraloHarness) gets a text field with the keyboard in each app of apps.toml. `open` is one of: document (open an empty scratch file with the app; `extension` names its type), web-page (open a scratch page whose text area takes the focus), shell (open a scratch script in the terminal: a zsh line editor that runs nothing), keys (bring the app forward and press `keys`), manual (a person clicks into a field; skipped when nobody is there). `clear` is select-all (Cmd+A, Delete; the default) or kill-line (Ctrl+U). `settle_ms` is how long the app gets after it comes forward [1500]. None of these recipes has been run yet: the first matrix run corrects them. An app of apps.toml with no recipe here is treated as manual.
